sources.name: Tournament decklists (Magic Online)
sources.note: Last 42 days, a list counting half as much for every 14 days since it was played. Magic Online: 106 tournaments, 1718 lists from Challenges and other events, 416 from leagues. A league shows only its 5-0 lists, so one counts a third. Named with the rules of Badaro/MTGOFormatData. This is tournament play, mostly best of three, not the Arena ladder.

cards: Yera and Oski, Weaver and Guide
